data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 the Syndicate strengthened technical reserves by $229k in respect of prior periods (2017: release of $267k) arising predominantly from the Property Division. The strengthening was due to adverse claims development on prior year losses during 2018.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate strengthened its prior-year claims reserves by $229k (approximately 0.229 million USD), driven predominantly by adverse claims development in the Property division. This movement represents a 2.56% increase versus the opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018. No specific named prior-year catastrophe events are identified in the movement note.
raw_causal_phrases: arising predominantly from the Property Division.
The strengthening was due to adverse claims development on prior year losses during 2018.
data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are reported in the report's functional currency (USD) and converted to millions. Opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior-year movement is taken from the Movement in prior year's provision note which explicitly states $229k strengthening (assumed gross). The segmental analysis shows a small negative Marine premium (-$6k) which may reflect adjustments/rounding. Claims development triangle is presented in $'000 units (see _claims_triangle).
